native_criterion:
# Outer Vector batch controller: source and native discriminator

This scratch serves one source/compiler experiment: reduce the repeated batch
controller's live seed/trip-bound state without changing any public Vector
operation, compiler, representation, policy, workload or accepted rule. It lives
beside the preserved batch experiment in /private/tmp and retires after the
owning experiment retains its source and result. Root authorized source and
native screening after the existing nullable phase; performance timing is not
authorized. Do not overwrite or retime any prior source/candidate.

## Changed ground and preserved behavior

The rejected remaining-count probe in Vector RESULTS changed only the
compiler-generated INNER terminal traversal's cursor/remaining induction;
timed/account objects were byte-identical. This variant changes only the
private generic OUTER vector_library_suffix_cycles source controller derived
from admitted batch source SHA6724cfcefe503cd26cdf05734a28bb2365c366a5cab731aaed8ca7b1c5ae1a50.
The inner suffix for-loop, public append/truncate, callback and compiler remain
unchanged. The original scalar tail already inlines, so no inline hint is
proposed. No type, capacity, count or workload selector is added.

Initialize pending=rounds and next_seed=seed. Before each cycle, break exactly
when pending=0; otherwise run the original append/truncate/digest/checksum
statements, then increment next_seed with wrapping arithmetic and subtract one
from positive pending. After k completed cycles, pending=rounds-k over integers
and next_seed=seed+k modulo2^64. Thus there are exactly rounds cycles, in the
same order and with the same seeds, including seed wrap and maximal u64 rounds.
Zero rounds returns initial_checksum without a cycle. Removed=0 still calls
truncate once per cycle. Prefix construction/final drain/free, allocation and
growth policy, all callback/failure/divergence orders and body-scope releases
are unchanged. Updated controller locals have no observable address/effect.

GRAM-4/INV-1 admit an ordinary labelled loop with only invariant header clauses.
The preserved prefix_length invariant is proved at entry by the old >=/<=
requires clauses, at the backedge by truncate's ensures and at break by the
current header. The pending>0 guard discharges the checked subtraction domain
under OP-2; wrapping seed increment is total under OP-1. No counted binder or
false-header exhaustion fact is claimed for this ordinary loop. These same
forms exist in the frozen CLI's specification and existing truncate source.

## Preregistered native criterion

First run frozen CLI --check; stop on any unexpected source rejection, preserving
its direct status and diagnostic. Only admission permits --emit-llvm and the
unchanged ordinary /usr/bin/clang -O3 consumer. Preserve exactly one fixture-main
rename and no other LLVM edit. Verify compiler, sources, old comparison
artifacts and all18 older non-WF inputs before and after the screen. Compare
actual optimized LLVM, assembly AND object disassembly, both payload widths
and every emitted body, not total counts alone. No rebuild or flag sweep.

Scalar original trace instance8f6b633c945d12a3 has a no-growth cycle of
21+16*removed instructions; the admitted batch has23+16*removed. In batch
candidate.s1147/1138 the immutable seed and round bound reload every cycle;
1148 derives the digest seed from seed+index. The code prediction is a rolling
seed and remaining-count backedge without these immutable per-cycle reloads.
Require no extra hot branch, owner-slot store/reload, compensating spill or
helper call; actual full scalar no-growth path must be no larger than the
original21+16*removed (69 at removed3). Preserve outer backing pointer/length
promotion, capacity tests, growth/movement/release paths, forward scalar digest
loads and final length publication. Moving an allocation/memory call, altering
payload work/order or leaving any owner unreleased cannot satisfy the screen.

Wide instancec3abe4db44181f7a must retain admitted batch's constant preparation
and seven Q-pair saves outside repeated cycles, direct one-record backing
stores/SIMD preparation, and no new owner-sized snapshot, repeated constant
preparation, hot helper call, additional hot spills or moved memory/allocation
operation. Existing seven Q-pair reloads per nonempty truncate remain visible;
no elapsed saving is inferred from instruction counts. Prefix/final drain,
zero-round and zero-suffix arms and all other functions must retain their
operations and ownership effects; list every changed function/frame/call.

Any failure refuses this native discriminator before behavioral qualification
or timing; no adaptive source/option change or automatic retry is authorized.
A native pass permits reporting readiness only. Same-behavior qualification
must still be reviewed before any separately authorized full timing. Original
batch scalar suffix3/16 loss and old no-qualified-useful-loss criterion remain
unchanged; no target-policy tradeoff is decided here.
